results.name: stateContainer
results.reason: Learn selectorで2026-09-01を最新GAと確認し、固定REST openapi.jsonのcurrent 2026-04-01とGA 2026-09-01 BlobContainer/ContainerPropertiesをSchemasで照合。publicAccess enumは両方でContainer/Blob/None、name制約3..63に実名が適合。
results.migration: GA移行可能。2026-09-01のused properties.publicAccess/name/parent routeはcurrentと同じ。change logのblobAccessPointConfiguration追加は未使用のoptional field。

findings.detail: 最新GA candidate 2026-09-01がcurrent 2026-04-01より新しい。両schemaでpublicAccess enumと使用属性に差はなく、追加されたblobAccessPointConfigurationは未使用。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name is Bicep child resource identity and REST containerName route string. Literal 'external-sli-state' is lowercase/hyphen and length 18, within Learn documented 3..63. REST marks name readOnly as response identity, not mutable property.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /parent is Bicep parent relationship, not REST JSON. BlobService parent scopes route storageAccounts/{accountName}/blobServices/default/containers/{containerName}.

usage.label: properties

usage.label: publicAccess
